title: AI Arrange improvement — raise criterion from 78 to 90+ (UX scoring matrix)
deliberation_reason: New track created per UX scoring matrix gap analysis; multiple defensible approaches exist (user preview/override, undo granularity, AI decision explanation, confidence scoring). Must run OSD before committing to a cluster.

phase0.summary: Nominate the AI Arrange cluster(s) to improve. Candidates: (a) user preview/override before apply — show proposed arrangement, let user accept/reject/modify, (b) undo granularity — per-step undo vs all-or-nothing, (c) AI decision explanation — surface why sections were moved/grouped, (d) confidence scoring — show confidence per move, let user filter low-confidence suggestions. Run OSD to pick one cluster for Phase 1.

phase1.summary: Implement the nominated AI Arrange improvement cluster behind window.AIArrange seam (extend existing) or new module. Must pass: eslint clean, npm run lint, all existing unit tests (no regressions), ai_layout_schema.test.js (142 cases) and byok_arrange_roundtrip.spec.js (6 E2E) stay green.

phase2.summary: N/A unless new measured premise (e.g., arrangement quality metric validated against user study).

phase3.summary: Guard-discipline continuity: injected-scope collision, dead-exports, scripts hygiene, full suite, lint, smoke — all green. Add AI Arrange regression test(s) for the new capability.

phase4.summary: Checkpoint + frontier review + consultant verification (3 consultants).

phase5.summary: Register, seal, hand-over. Target: AI Arrange criterion >= 90 on next UX scoring run.

context.gap_analysis: Fleet certified ai_layout_schema.test.js (142 cases) and byok_arrange_roundtrip.spec.js (6 E2E), but the 'usefulness and user control' dimension rates lower. Likely gaps: user override/preview before apply, undo granularity, or explanation of AI decisions.
